messages:
maya: quick idea — add a /deploy prepare that schedules change windows in GCal and runs pin-checks automatically
aj: ooh nice. do we create events in a shared redwood calendar or try to create events on behalf of teams? :thinking_face:
carmen: shared redwood calendar for internal ops, but events should include a link for teams to invite external participants if needed
maya: rough feature set i was thinking:
- /deploy prepare <service> <version> --cw "2024-07-11 22:00-23:00" --dry-run
- bot creates calendar event, runs pin-check, posts a compact preflight summary in the channel
- if pin-check fails, bot posts the failing diffs and suggests rollback commands
aj: how would pin-check surface problems? full diffs are noisy in slack
carmen: keep it terse — a 1-line verdict + tiny diff block and a link to the detailed manifest diff. like:
`pin-check: MISMATCH (2 files)`
```diff
- database-migrations: v1.4.0
+ database-migrations: v1.5.0
```
sachin: +1. also allow `--skip-cw` for emergency quick rollouts
devex-bot: idea logged: DEVEX-421 "schedule-cw-pin-check command"
deploy-bot: preflightDryRun started for service=auth, version=v2.9.3
deploy-bot: pin-check: MISMATCH
deploy-bot: diff:
```diff
- database-migrations: v1.4.0
+ database-migrations: v1.5.0
```
maya: exactly. then deploy-bot should suggest `!rollback-suggest --to v2.9.2` and offer a `!hold-until` calendar hook to block the change window if we want more time
aj: +1 on rollback sugg. we should also auto-generate a compact release-note snippet: one-line summary + issue links + canary plan
carmen: UX note: calendar event template should include change-window template (canary cadence, rollback window, contacts) prefilled from the service manifest
sachin: question: who is allowed to create events? need svc-account with limited scopes and an explicit consent flow (first-time authorize)
maya: yes — devex will add a consent flow and restrict command to owners or release leads by default
aj: logging requirement: calendar event id + pin-check result should be attached to release metadata and the release-notes payload
maya: can someone draft a minimal CLI arg spec and the calendar template? volunteers?
carmen: i'll draft the calendar/template copy, short and copyable
sachin: i'll prototype the calendar svc-account permissions and consent flow
aj: i'll wire the pin-check CLI into deploy-bot and make the preflight summary compact
maya: timeline: PRs by EOW?
carmen: aiming for Thurs EOD for the template
sachin: prototype ETA Wed, will ping #eng-releases when ready
maya: one more safety idea: if deploy-bot reports `pin-check: MISMATCH` it should automatically add an escape-hatch annotation to the calendar event and ping `@oncall` with a `!hold` button
deploy-bot: noted — action created: add-escape-hatch-annotation to DEVEX-421
maya: nice. oh and small CLI examples to include in docs:
`/deploy prepare auth v2.9.3 --cw "2024-07-11 22:00-23:00" --notes "fix auth token caching"`
`/deploy prepare webapp v1.2.0 --dry-run --notify #release-notes`
`!rollback-suggest --service auth --from v2.9.3 --to v2.9.2`
aj: think about a compact json blob for release notes so external tools can ingest it: {summary, issues[], change_window, calendar_event_id, pin_check_status}
carmen: i'll include that in the template. keep fields tiny
maya: ok team — sounds actionable. i'll open a meta PR outlining the command surface and basic flow. ty everyone :thumbsup:
